ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit diagram, on the left is a 1 A current source, connected to the top node through the upper switch S1; the bottom is the common lower node. Between the top node and the lower node there is a capacitor labeled 0.01 F, and the reference direction of the capacitor current ic is downward. The middle branch is a 100 Ω resistor in series with a 1 H inductor, with the resistor above and the inductor below. On the right there is switch S2, which when closed connects the top node to the middle node between the 100 Ω resistor and the inductor, thus bypassing the 100 Ω resistor. On the far right there is also a 25 Ω resistor connected between the top node and the bottom node. Reasoning: When t<0, S1 is closed, S2 is open, and this has lasted for a long time, so it is in DC steady state. The capacitor is equivalent to an open circuit, and the inductor is equivalent to a short circuit, so the 1 A current source drives two parallel branches: the 100 Ω branch and the 25 Ω branch. The equivalent resistance is 100 Ω || 25 Ω = 20 Ω, so the top node voltage is 1 A × 20 Ω = 20 V. Therefore vC(0-) = 20 V. The 100 Ω branch current is 20/100 = 0.2 A, directed downward, so the inductor current iL(0-) = 0.2 A downward. At t=0+, S1 opens and S2 closes. The capacitor voltage cannot change abruptly, so vC(0+) = 20 V; the inductor current cannot change abruptly, so iL(0+) = 0.2 A downward. After S2 closes, the 100 Ω is short-circuited, and the capacitor, inductor, and 25 Ω resistor are all connected between the same pair of upper and lower nodes. The 25 Ω resistor current is 20/25 = 0.8 A, directed downward. Write KCL at the top node after the source is disconnected, taking downward current as positive: ic(0+) + 0.8 + 0.2 = 0, therefore ic(0+) = -1.0 A.

raw_record.question_text: The switch \( S_1 \) was closed and \( S_2 \) was open for a long time. At \( t = 0 \), switch \( S_1 \) is opened and \( S_2 \) is closed simultaneously. The value of \( i_c(0^+) \), in amperes, is ____.

method.method_draft: From the image, first analyze the t<0 circuit with S1 closed and S2 open. At DC steady state, replace the capacitor by an open circuit and the inductor by a short circuit, so the 1 A source drives parallel branches of 100 Ω and 25 Ω. Compute the top-node voltage as 1 A times (100 Ω || 25 Ω) = 20 V, so vC(0-) = 20 V, and the inductor current is the 100 Ω branch current, 20/100 = 0.2 A downward. At t=0+, S1 is open and S2 is closed; S2 shorts out the 100 Ω resistor, leaving the capacitor, inductor, and 25 Ω resistor all connected between the same top and bottom nodes. By continuity, vC(0+) = 20 V and iL(0+) = 0.2 A downward. The 25 Ω resistor current is 20/25 = 0.8 A downward. Apply KCL at the isolated top node with downward currents positive: ic(0+) + 0.8 + 0.2 = 0, giving ic(0+) = -1.0 A.

method.method_draft: Use the image to identify the initial DC network for t<0: because S1 is closed and S2 is open, the 1 A source supplies the parallel combination of the 25 Ω branch and the 100 Ω-plus-shorted-inductor branch, while the capacitor branch is open. Thus the capacitor’s initial voltage is the rail voltage, 1 A · (25 Ω || 100 Ω) = 20 V, and the inductor’s initial current equals the current in the 100 Ω branch, 20/100 = 0.2 A downward. For the instantaneous t=0+ equivalent, open S1 and close S2 as stated in the text and as located in the image: the 100 Ω resistor is bypassed, the 25 Ω resistor is across the capacitor voltage, and the inductor current source of 0.2 A is also connected from the top node to bottom node. Replace the capacitor at that instant by a 20 V source with unknown current ic through it, replace the inductor by a 0.2 A downward current source, and compute the 25 Ω current as 0.8 A downward. Since the left source is isolated by open S1, the ideal capacitor voltage source must supply the sum of those downward currents; with ic defined downward, ic(0+) = -(0.8 + 0.2) = -1.0 A.

图像描述：图中左侧是一个 1 A 电流源，通过上方开关 S1 接到右侧主电路的上母线；下方是公共下母线。右侧主电路中有一个 0.01 F 电容竖直接在上下母线之间，电容电流 ic 的参考方向在图中标为向下。中间支路由上方 100 Ω 电阻和下方 1 H 电感串联组成，100 Ω 与电感的中间节点通过开关 S2 可接到上母线，因此 S2 闭合时会旁路 100 Ω 电阻。最右侧还有一个 25 Ω 电阻接在上下母线之间。

推理：t<0 时，S1 闭合、S2 断开，并且已持续很长时间，所以处于直流稳态。直流稳态下电容开路，电感短路。因此 1 A 电流源供给两个并联支路：25 Ω 支路和 100 Ω 加短路电感支路，即 25 Ω || 100 Ω。等效电阻为 (25×100)/(25+100)=20 Ω，所以电容两端初始电压等于母线电压：vc(0-)=1 A × 20 Ω = 20 V，上端为正。电感初始电流等于 100 Ω 支路电流：iL(0-)=20/100=0.2 A，方向向下。

由于电容电压和电感电流不能突变，t=0+ 时 vc(0+)=20 V，iL(0+)=0.2 A 向下。此时 S1 打开，所以左侧 1 A 电流源被隔离；S2 闭合，所以 100 Ω 电阻被旁路，电感直接接在上、下母线之间。25 Ω 电阻也接在同一 20 V 电压下，因此其电流为 20/25=0.8 A，方向向下。t=0+ 的上节点没有左侧电流源供电，向下流过 25 Ω 电阻和电感的电流总和为 0.8+0.2=1.0 A。因此电容必须提供相反方向的电流，即实际电容电流向上 1.0 A。由于图中 ic 的参考方向定义为向下，所以 ic(0+) = -1.0 A。

由于电容电压和电感电流不能突变，t=0+ 时 vc(0+)=20 V，iL(0+)=0.2 A 向下。此时 S1 打开，所以左侧 1 A 电流源被隔离；S2 闭合，所以 100 Ω 电阻被旁路，电感直接接在上、下母线之间。25 Ω 电阻也接在同一 20 V 电压下，因此其电流为 20/25=0.8 A，方向向下。t=0+ 的上节点没有左侧电流源供电，向下流过 25 Ω 电阻和电感的电流总和为 0.8+0.2=1.0 A。因此电容必须提供相反方向的电流，即实际电容电流向上 1.0 A。由于图中 ic 的参考方向定义为向下，所以 ic(0+) = -1.0 A。

raw_record.original_question: The switch \( S_1 \) was closed and \( S_2 \) was open for a long time. At \( t = 0 \), switch \( S_1 \) is opened and \( S_2 \) is closed simultaneously. The value of \( i_c(0^+) \), in amperes, is ____.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the circuit diagram, on the left side there is a 1 A current source, connected to the top node through the upper switch S1; the bottom is the common lower node. Between the top node and the lower node there is a capacitor labeled 0.01 F, and the reference direction of the capacitor current ic is downward. The middle branch is a 100 Ω resistor in series with a 1 H inductor, with the resistor on top and the inductor below. On the right side there is switch S2, which when closed connects the top node to the middle node between the 100 Ω resistor and the inductor, therefore bypassing the 100 Ω resistor. On the far right there is also a 25 Ω resistor connected between the top node and the bottom node.

Reasoning: When t<0, S1 is closed, S2 is open, and this has lasted for a long time, so it is in DC steady state. The capacitor is equivalent to an open circuit, and the inductor is equivalent to a short circuit, therefore the 1 A current source drives two parallel branches: the 100 Ω branch and the 25 Ω branch. The equivalent resistance is 100 Ω || 25 Ω = 20 Ω, so the top node voltage is 1 A × 20 Ω = 20 V. Therefore vC(0-) = 20 V. The 100 Ω branch current is 20/100 = 0.2 A, directed downward, so the inductor current iL(0-) = 0.2 A downward.

At t=0+, S1 opens and S2 closes. The capacitor voltage cannot change abruptly, so vC(0+) = 20 V; the inductor current cannot change abruptly, so iL(0+) = 0.2 A downward. After S2 closes, the 100 Ω is short-circuited, and the capacitor, inductor, and 25 Ω resistor are all connected between the same pair of upper and lower nodes. The 25 Ω resistor current is 20/25 = 0.8 A, directed downward. Writing KCL at the top node after the source is disconnected, taking downward current as positive: ic(0+) + 0.8 + 0.2 = 0, therefore ic(0+) = -1.0 A.
